question: Should ClawHub adopt the proposed experimental `claw` package family and v1 manifest/storage contract while the Claws RFC remains open?
rationale: The patch intentionally creates a new exported package variant and persisted data contract whose permanence, versioning, and relationship to the remaining stack cannot be decided from correctness checks alone.

options.title: Approve the experimental contract
options.body: Accept this schema direction subject to rebase, inspectable proof, and ordered review of the gated publication and read surfaces.

options.title: Wait for RFC acceptance
options.body: Keep the draft open but do not merge the public and persisted contract until the Claws RFC and compatibility boundaries are explicitly accepted.

options.title: Decline the registry family
options.body: Keep complete-agent packaging outside ClawHub's shared package model and close or redesign the four-PR stack.

recommendation.title: Wait for RFC acceptance
recommendation.body: Keep the draft open but do not merge the public and persisted contract until the Claws RFC and compatibility boundaries are explicitly accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the governing Claws RFC and are the clearest available owner for deciding whether this registry contract matches the intended product model.
